source.title: Danger and distress: Parabrachial-extended amygdala circuits.

confidence_rationale: A cell-type-aware review that explicitly deconstructs parabrachial-to-extended-amygdala signalling into interoceptive and exteroceptive components, arguing PBN -> CeA modulates innate response to physical stimuli while PBN -> BNST modulates unpredictable distress. This is the most direct literature support for MECH-282's architectural framing of the PBN as a relay that segregates alarming interoceptive vs exteroceptive stimuli before handing them to the extended amygdala. Confidence moderate because it is a synthesis/hypothesis review, not primary data, and its interoceptive/exteroceptive split is drawn along a CeA-vs-BNST axis rather than the within-z_harm separability axis MECH-282 specifies.
failure_signatures: The review's interoceptive/exteroceptive dissociation is mapped onto PBN -> CeA (physical/innate) vs PBN -> BNST (unpredictable distress), and it notes the two circuits are partly intertwined and reciprocal -- so the segregation MECH-282 wants is real but leakier and routed differently than the claim's CeA-centric statement implies.
As a review it inherits the rodent-dominant primary literature and provides no new causal test of an interoceptive z_harm channel separable from external-threat z_harm.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The parabrachial nucleus provides a pathway for alarming interoceptive and exteroceptive stimuli to be processed and relayed to the extended amygdala; PBN -> CeA modulates innate responses to physical stimuli and fear conditioning, while PBN -> BNST modulates distress in unpredictable contexts, with the two circuits partly redundant, intertwined, and reciprocal.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports MECH-282's core architecture: the LPB analog is an upstream relay that broadcasts distress into the harm-arbitration network, and it carries a dissociable interoceptive component alongside the exteroceptive one. The review's explicit interoceptive-vs-exteroceptive deconstruction is the conceptual scaffold MECH-282 instantiates.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The review locates the interoceptive/exteroceptive dissociation primarily along a target axis (CeA vs BNST) and stresses that the circuits are intertwined and reciprocal, whereas MECH-282 asserts a separable interoceptive *input* channel feeding the same CeA-centred arbitration. The biological dissociation is therefore supported in spirit but is leakier and topographically different from the clean separable-channel commitment in the claim.
mapping.source_context: Narrative/mechanistic review of cell-type-specific PBN -> CeA and PBN -> BNST circuits in rodent affect and stress paradigms.

confidence_components.notes: Strong, well-cited review but secondary evidence. Mapping fidelity good for the interoceptive/exteroceptive segregation concept; lowered by the CeA-vs-BNST framing diverging from MECH-282's within-CeA separability statement. Transfer risk moderate (rodent circuit synthesis -> REE harm-arbitration substrate).
